verified_facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Stadtpark in the heart of Vienna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the ornate Stadtpark, InterContinental Vienna puts you in the heart of the city.

verified_facts.text: The Stadtpark is located opposite the hotel's main entrance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stadtpark, located opposite the main entrance of the hotel, is an oasis of calm and relaxation right in the city centre.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is moments away from the Vienna State Opera and shopping on pedestrianised Kaerntner Strasse.
verified_facts.excerpt: The InterContinental Vienna hotel places you moments away from the world-renowned Vienna State Opera and stylish shopping on pedestrianised Kaerntner Strasse.

verified_facts.text: Behind its functionalist exterior, the hotel has a wood-panelled lobby hung with chandeliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Behind its functionalist exterior, the hotel's magnificent wood-panelled lobby is hung with chandeliers

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a grand ballroom for hosting events.
verified_facts.excerpt: our grand ballroom is ideal for hosting elegant events

verified_facts.text: Club InterContinental guests enjoy a 180-degree panoramic view over downtown Vienna from the Club Lounge on the 12th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club InterContinental guests enjoy a 180-degree panoramic view over downtown Vienna from the Club Lounge on the 12th floor of the hotel

verified_facts.text: Classic rooms blend traditional and contemporary furnishings and have views of the Stadtpark or the Vienna Concert Hall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Classic rooms elegantly blend traditional and contemporary furnishings, and have lovely views of the Stadtpark or Vienna Concert Hall.

verified_facts.text: Cafe Vienna is a Viennese coffee house serving coffee specialties and pastries, with traditional afternoon tea in the afternoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Café Vienna is a typical Viennese coffee house with coffee specialties, pastries, and typical cold and hot dishes. In the afternoon, traditional afternoon tea is served.

verified_facts.text: The Intermezzo Bar has a polished central bar under an opulent chandelier and serves fine wines, whiskies and cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a polished central bar under an opulent chandelier, the sophisticated Intermezzo Bar serves fine wines, whiskies and cocktails

verified_facts.text: Concerts at the Vienna Konzerthaus and Musikverein are within easy reach by subway.
verified_facts.excerpt: Concerts at the Vienna Konzerthaus and Musikverein are within easy reach by subway.

verified_facts.text: Fashion boutiques on Kaerntner Strasse and Kohlmarkt are a short stroll away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fashion boutiques on Kärntner Strasse and Kohlmarkt are a short stroll away.

verified_facts.text: The Stadtpark opposite the hotel has a golden Johann Strauss monument.
verified_facts.excerpt: its golden Johann Strauss monument is one of the world's most frequently photographed memorials

verified_facts.text: The hotel is certified with the Austrian Eco-Label and holds Green Key certification.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is certified with the Austrian Eco-Label and adheres to the strict requirements of Green Engage, IHG’s global CSR programme. We are also proud to hold the international Green Key certification

verified_facts.text: Pet dogs are allowed in guest rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pet dogs are allowed in room.
